people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziba
people.line: Servant of Saul's household, later served David

translations.web: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
translations.bsb: And there was a servant of the house of Saul named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?” “I am your servant,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
translations.asv: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him unto David; and the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
